name: Avocado ice cream
summary: Blended avocado dessert sold around Da Lat’s market slope, eaten cold from a cup. The 12 Jun 2026 Da Nang markets page names kem bơ in the Con Market snack row and does not describe the cup.
origin: A sweet sold around Da Lat Market. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names the avocado dessert with the market.
howToEat: Eat it standing at the counter while it is still cold.
Eat it as a snack. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism prints no stall price. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.
where: Counters on the Da Lat Market slope and at the night market. The food-tour note also names 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi.
In Da Nang, the Con Market snack row on the 12 Jun 2026 page, with bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo, ốc hút, and chè. The page prints 290 Hùng Vương and 06:00–19:00. A Da Nang price is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism prints no stall price. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi. A Da Nang price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Avocado ice cream — Da Lat kem bo
seoDescription: Kem bơ, blended avocado, at Da Lat Market and the night stalls. One food-tour note prints 20,000–30,000 VND at 76 Nguyễn Văn Trỗi. Con Market in Da Nang names the cup and prints no price.
